tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document or spreadsheet and open it in the MR Office editor for the person to see and edit. A document's content is Markdown (headings, lists, tables, emphasis); a spreadsheet's is CSV. `format` is the file it is exported as by default (docx or md for documents, csv for spreadsheets).

content.description: Markdown for a document, CSV for a spreadsheet

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open a file in the MR Office editor for the person to see and edit: Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, Markdown, HTML, text, CSV. Give the file's bytes as base64 (`content_base64`), its text (`text`, for text formats), or an https `url` to fetch it from.

name.description: The file name, with its extension (it says which editor opens it)

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Replace the content of a document created or opened here with new Markdown (documents) or CSV (spreadsheets), as a new revision, and show it. Read it with get_document first: the person may have edited it.

expected_revision.description: The revision you read; the change is refused if the document moved on

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a document's current content, including the person's edits in the editor: Markdown for documents, CSV per sheet for spreadsheets. Set include_file to also get the editor's file.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: A picture (PNG) of one page of a document as the MR Office editor draws it, to check the layout of your work.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: The document as a file: docx (Word), md, html or mrdoc for documents; xlsx (Excel), csv or mrsheet for spreadsheets; pptx (PowerPoint) or mrslides for presentations. Word, Excel and PowerPoint files are written by MR Office's engine and need the person signed in (sign_in). Returns the file and a download link for the person.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The documents created or opened with this server, newest first.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign the person in to their MR Office account, which opening and saving Word, Excel and PowerPoint files needs. Opens MR Office's sign-in page in the person's browser and returns its link; the person signs in and allows it there, then the Office tools work. Says who is signed in when that is already done.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Sign this app out of the person's MR Office account and revoke its access.

tools.name: widget_load
tools.description: The editor view reads the document it shows.

tools.name: widget_save
tools.description: The editor view saves what the person changed, as a new revision.

findings.fix: Validate URL inputs against an allowlist of permitted destinations.

explanations.title: Unrestricted URL parameter
explanations.why_it_matters: A caller-controlled URL can expose the server to untrusted content and unintended network destinations.
explanations.remediation: Prefer fixed destinations or strict allowlists and validate URL scheme, host, and resolved address.
